newsitem.title: USA: MGE wheat ends lower but cash support near close.
newsitem.headline: MGE wheat ends lower but cash support near close.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed lower, but cash-connected buying in late trading limited the losses, traders said.
"There was good commercial buying on a scale-down basis," a trader said.
The cash demand was centered in the nearby May and the May/July spread narrowed Friday to close at eight cents per bushel, premium May.
MGE spring wheat futures closed 1-3/4 to 3-1/4 cents per bushel lower, with May down 1-3/4 at $3.97. September closed 1-3/4 lower at $3.89-1/4.
MGE spring wheat futures volume Friday totaled 23,722 contracts, about the same as the 23,567 traded Thursday.
MGE barley futures closed unchanged to 0.40 cents per cwt lower, with May unchanged at $6.61 per cwt.
